queries: longitudinal study AI generated misinformation online growth 2025 2026

sources_considered.why: Primary longitudinal research on synthetic misinformation in Community Notes; useful but observational and platform-specific.
Primary research providing both evidence of virality and qualifications concerning perceived harmfulness.
Read the earlier version, but used the revision available before the evaluation date.
The search result concerns news demand following an intervention, rather than the rate of internet contamination.

evidence_items.explanation: The study reports growth in flagged synthetic visual misinformation, including during 2025. The authors describe a correlation; this does not isolate causation or establish an internet-wide rate of degradation.

For posts collected through January 2025, the study finds greater virality but lower annotated believability and harmfulness for AI-generated misinformation. These assessments qualify a simple equation between more synthetic content and greater harm, but do not measure acceleration.

unresolved_gaps: The reviewed studies do not establish a broad causal increase in the rate of misinformation growth.
Community Notes samples depend on what users flag and do not represent all online content.
The speaker supplied no deadline or operational measure of degradation.
